## a23328d45092

**Finding A2 — a valid three-demonstration lesson can preserve a canonical-fitting size-gated priority shortcut and disagree on its query.**

Target generator v2.0.0 is unchanged at SHA-256 `3745386a4884c930be5ec923024ccaf619a296835074997c1eda677ab5c3cf57`; canonical rule hash is `564667358228`. With `seed=0`, `difficulty=None`, no overrides, consecutive samples `1,2,3` as demonstrations and sample `4` as query all pass `self_check` and are ordinary documented-domain outputs.

The rival `canonical_size_else_swap_TR_BL` uses the true `TL > TR > BL > BR` priority on 9×9 inputs, but swaps TR and BL on every other size. Every official canonical input is 9×9, so the rival fits all 7/7 usable canonical pairs. The generated demonstrations are 11×11, 7×9, and 9×7; the rival matches all three Racket outputs. The 9×10 query distinguishes it at output `(0,3)`: authority outputs colour 8, rival outputs colour 3.

A census over seeds `0..999`, starts `0..15`, and `None/easy/hard` evaluated 48,000 consecutive 3-demo-plus-query windows against all 23 noncanonical quadrant-priority permutations. 14,237 windows left at least one priority rival consistent with all demonstrations, and 6,610 windows had at least one such rival disagree on the query. The retained counterexample upgrades the simple swap into a canonical-fitting size-gated shortcut. The untouched battery finished 6 green, 2 advisory, 4 failed: lint, defect-lint, override contract, and active-authority exact-text sync. No semantic contract is declared.

Evidence: `checks/audit/a23328d45092/counterexample.json`, `input.json`, `rival.json`, `racket.json`, `checks/audit/failure-census.json`, and `checks/audit/a23328d45092/battery/checks/a23328d45092_before_battery_summary.json`.
